_note: Fixed public test keys (RFC 8032 section 7.1 tests 1 and 2); no private key is held here. HOST_DATA = sha256(domain || public key), and the domain ends in one zero byte. The customer key is written as unpadded base64url of exactly 32 bytes, checked strictly (URL-safe alphabet, no padding, canonical encoding), and is sent in the same form as "customer" in message 1. unlabelled_sha256_of_key is sha256(public key) with no domain: it must be refused. Read by the JS, Python and Go tests.

weak_keys.note: A customer key must never be a small-order Ed25519 point: for such a key a ticket verifies with no private key. small_order_hex holds the 8 canonical encodings (each checked here to have order dividing 8); non_canonical_hex holds encodings with y >= 2^255-19 or x = 0 with the sign bit set. A customer key equal to any of these is a usage error in every client and the box refuses it.

host_data_offset_note: HOST_DATA is bytes 0xC0 to 0xDF of the report; REPORT_DATA is 0x50 to 0x8F and MEASUREMENT 0x90 to 0xBF.
